## For you

**The spec.** Read these scenarios in the pull request's files:

- The notes export as Markdown, added (`features/notes.feature:27`)

**Also yours to approve:**

- the agent's instructions changed (`AGENTS.md`)
- a new dependency, example.com/newdep (`go.mod:17`)
- an incompatible change to the library's API, Make: changed from func(string) string to func(string, string) string (`pkg/slug`)

Approving the pull request approves these; touch one again and it needs approving again.
